title: calappa amara
intro: Calappa amara, commonly known as Bitter Calappa, is a plant species that belongs to the family Rutaceae and is native to certain regions of the world. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Calappa amara include flavonoids, limonoids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
